summary: Master safety accountability to reduce incidents and lead a proactive safety culture. Learn ISO 45001, BBS, and RCA strategies.
lede: Workplace safety accountability training helps safety managers, supervisors and operational leaders make ownership of hazards and controls visible. Participants practise mapping responsibilities, assessing safety indicators and near-miss data, verifying critical controls, and using just-culture reviews to learn from incidents. They also develop supervisor coaching plans, corrective-action tracking, and a dashboard specification to connect frontline actions with leadership reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assign, monitor, investigate, coach, or report workplace safety responsibilities across operational environments. It suits intermediate learners with practical exposure to occupational health and safety processes, incident reporting, or frontline supervision.
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to workplace safety processes, incident reporting, inspections, operational supervision, or safety management systems. Prior knowledge of ISO 45001 is useful but not essential. No programming is required. Advanced digital topics such as Power BI dashboard design and AI-assisted safety trend analysis are taught at an operational application level, not a software engineering level. Bring examples of anonymized safety observations, corrective actions, or reporting challenges if available.
